title: Comparison results
subtitle: How the advisor's plans stand against what routing did, order by order. An estimate sits beside an outcome, and the page never says which was better.

cost.title: Cost
cost.notice: No riyal total. of rates behind a plan's cost are assumed, so no riyal figure is summed.
cost.shipments: Shipments. The advisor's plans hold shipments against real deliveries.
cost.listFee: The customer's list fee, both sides under the advisor's fee rule: lower on of orders, the same on , higher on .

names.BEFORE_RESERVING_FLAGS_OFF: Made before the reserving flags went off

says.ASSUMED_RATES: Some delivery rates are assumptions until finance's rates arrive. The cost panel names them.
says.RANGE_NOT_CONFIRMED: A plan with a Dawaa Now shipment carries this mark until e-commerce hands over the range Hybris sells.
says.FEE_RULES_NOT_CONFIRMED: Fees are read off past deliveries, not from Hybris.
says.EXPRESS_RECORD_NOT_MEASURED: Dawaa Now's store record is the callout ignore rate alone until it is measured.
says.NO_ROUTING_EQUIVALENT: A plan with a mode routing does not have today, such as a carrier shipment.
says.BEFORE_RESERVING_FLAGS_OFF: Runs made while the reserving flags were still on read the stock another way.

differ.reference: The plan that was followed: nothing to estimate
differ.note: The left column is an estimate of a plan that was never tried. The right column is what really happened to the plan that was. The page sets them side by side and does not say which was better: the advisor is judged by outcome only where its plan was followed, in the promise check and the stock check.
